
{{alias}}( a, shift )
    Performs bitwise shift to the right on a 64-bit unsigned integer.

    Parameters
    ----------
    a: Uint64
        64-bit unsigned integer.

    shift: integer
        Number of bits to shift (0-63).

    Returns
    -------
    out: Uint64
        Result.

    Examples
    --------
    > var a = new {{alias:@stdlib/number/uint64/ctor}}( 10 )
    <Uint64>[ 10n ]
    > var out = {{alias}}( a, 1 )
    <Uint64>[ 5n ]


{{alias}}.assign( ah, al, shift, out, stride, offset )
    Performs bitwise shift to the right on a 64-bit unsigned integer and assigns
    results to a provided output array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    ah: integer
        High 32-bit word of the 64-bit unsigned integer.

    al: integer
        Low 32-bit word of the 64-bit unsigned integer.

    shift: integer
        Number of bits to shift (0-63).

    out: ArrayLikeObject
        Output array.

    stride: integer
        Stride length.

    offset: integer
        Starting index.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ArrayLikeObject
        Output array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint32}}( 2 );
    > {{alias}}.assign( 2, 4, 1, out, 1, 0 )
    <Uint32Array>[ 1, 2 ]


{{alias}}.strided( a, sa, oa, shift, out, so, oo )
    Performs bitwise shift to the right on a 64-bit unsigned integer stored in
    integer-valued strided array views and assigns results to a provided strided
    output array.

    Parameters
    ----------
    a: ArrayLikeObject
        64-bit unsigned integer strided array view containing interleaved 32-bit
        unsigned integer high and low order words.

    sa: integer
        Stride length for `a`.

    oa: integer
        Starting index for `a`.

    shift: integer
        Number of bits to shift (0-63).

    out: ArrayLikeObject
        Output array.

    so: integer
        Stride length for `out`.

    oo: integer
        Starting index for `out`.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ArrayLikeObject
        Output array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var a = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint32}}( [ 2, 4 ] );
    > var out = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/uint32}}( 2 );
    > {{alias}}.strided( a, 1, 0, 1, out, 1, 0 )
    <Uint32Array>[ 1, 2 ]

    See Also
    --------
